title: schc.h: remove dead constants (SCHC_MAX_ACK_REQUESTS/RETRANSMISSION_TIMEOUT/INACTIVITY/RCS_BYTES) + update spec-coverage citations
description: Deferred from b7z9.92 (reviewer finding). lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/include/lichen/schc.h:106-109 defines SCHC_RCS_BYTES, SCHC_RETRANSMISSION_TIMEOUT_S, SCHC_MAX_ACK_REQUESTS, SCHC_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_S — zero code references (verified grep across lichen/, rust/, python/). BUT docs/spec-coverage/03-adaptation.md:63 (R-03-042) and :77 (R-03-056) cite these constants as the C evidence for those requirements. Removing the constants without updating the docs makes the traceability citations dangle. FIX: remove the 4 constants AND update docs/spec-coverage/03-adaptation.md rows R-03-042/R-03-056 to point at the real C evidence (or mark the C side as not-implemented if the fragmentation/session authority that owns these is not yet landed — see l1qw.3.7.6.x). Do not remove the constants alone.
